programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield is really unhappy because he has to be on diet. And he's having nightmares about it.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon can't manage to sleep. He's tried everything, to no avail. But Dr. Somnambulo has a new machine: the hypno-doron, still in work-in-progress.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Liz brings back an old mirror from her travels in Egypt. This one is enchanted and opens a door towards ancient Egypt where a Goddess, Neferkitty, has a secret wish: conquering the human world.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.title: Chased Dreamers
programme.desc: To craft their own hourglasses and become official Dream Chasers for the Night Bureau, Mateo and his friends must defeat the Dream Forge guardian.

programme.title: The Dream Forge
programme.desc: As time runs out to face the Dream Forge and become official Dream Chasers, Mateo and his friends enlist the help of the mysterious Dream Bandit.

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle and also Kai enters Zane's mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Country Girls
programme.desc: When the girls go to Mia's grandparents' ranch and Olivia accidentally knocks down the neighbor's barn, the girls promise to raise money to rebuild it and now have to learn to set aside their differences and work together to make good on their promise. Mia invites her friends to her grandparents' ranch for the weekend. But when Olivia accidentally knocks down a neighbor's barn with a tractor, the girls promise to raise the money to rebuild it themselves. Complicating matters, Mia and Stephanie turn out to like the same boy, Martin. They'll have to learn to set aside their differences and work together if they're going to raise enough money to make good on their promise.

programme.title: Emma's Dilemma
programme.desc: When Stephanie becomes obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in a float building contest and accidentally disregards Emma's ideas and design, Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to get revenge on Stephanie. When the girls enter a float-building contest, Emma is especially excited to share her design idea for the float. But no one is listening to her, especially Stephanie, who's become obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in the contest. Emma finally does find someone who appreciates her design… Tanya! Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to build the float design. But is Tanya just using Emma to get revenge on Stephanie?

programme.title: Friends of The Jungle
programme.desc: When Olivia's Aunt Sophie is getting married and the groom has gone missing in the jungle, the girls fly out to the jungle in secret to try to find him in time for the wedding. The girls are super excited to be planning a wedding for Olivia's Aunt Sophie. There's just one little problem: Olivia learns that the groom has gone missing in the jungle while working at an animal rescue station! Not wanting to worry her aunt, Olivia, Stephanie and Mia secretly fly to the jungle to try and find the groom, Henry, rescuing a few animals along the way. Too bad Emma and Andrea couldn't keep the secret back in Heartlake City. Now, Sophie, Emma and Andrea join the others in the jungle to try and find Henry before the rapidly approaching wedding date!

programme.title: Can Of Worms
programme.desc: Lloyd moves in and tries to make nice by helping out with chores, but he just gets in the way. Pythor has awoken the Vipoids and the Constrictaurs and an all out snake war has taken over Ninjago. The Ninja are not faring well, when a mysterious Samurai shows up and saves the day.

programme.title: Darkness Shall Rise
programme.desc: With the Devourer destroyed, Ninjago is saved and the rebuilding effort begins. Without their Golden Weapons, the Ninja are stripped of their elemental powers. And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas come to realize that evil has started to resurface with Lord Garmadon forging the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Royal Drum: No one believes Grandpa Smurf when he tells of far-away jungles and savannahs teeming with wild giant cats, striped horses, long-necked leaf-eaters and strange tribes... Only some Smurflings give some credit to his tales. But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Kow-Tow, We Won't Bow: Smurfette leads the Smurflings on a nature hike, but Puppy gets too far ahead and they chase him into the land of the Wartmongers. King Bullrush captures them in bubbles and imprisons them. A group of rebels rescue the Smurflings and they escape on the back of Puppy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf On The Wild Side, Part I: What, or who, is that strange being in the forest? It looks vaguely like a Smurf, but it chatters away like the squirrel that seems to be accompanying it… And why is Papa Smurf talking about the Lost Smurfling?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Snappy's Puppet: Snappy has a new trick: he frightens everybody, or tries to, with his hand-puppet dragon. But it gets, shall we say, out of hand when Papa Smurf's magic liquid falls on the puppet and it comes alive. Alive and kicking, what's more, endangering Snappy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - No Smurf Is An Island: Handy Smurf is the one who fixes everything that needs mending in the Village of the Smurfs. But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Crooner Smurf: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Baby Smurf Is Missing: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Smurfing Out Of Time: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. They go on a visit to Father Time and come across the River of Time, the great current that flows along majestically, carrying with it all the time in the world. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Memory Melon: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf For Denisa: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Peewit's Unscrupulous Adventure: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Poltersmurf: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Greedy And The Porridge Pot: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Most Unsmurfy Games: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Noble Stag: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.desc: Rabbids try to fit in, stand out and figure themselves out… badly.

programme.desc: Falls, fumbles and fizzy chaos in peak Rabbid slapstick mode.

programme.title: S3 Creative Bwah‑terpieces
programme.desc: Art, film and “masterpieces” go hilariously wrong in Rabbid hands.

programme.title: S3 Beware the Bwah‑gic

programme.title: 30 Days Of Night
programme.desc: Barrow, Alaska: A remote, isolated town that is plunged into a state of complete darkness for 30 days every winter. It is here that a group of marauding, merciless and bloodthirsty vampires, led by Marlow (Danny Huston), are coming. Their intention? A month long, uninterrupted feast of its helpless residents. It is up to Sheriff Eben (Josh Hartnett), his estranged wife, Stella (Melissa George), and an ever-shrinking group of survivors to do anything and everything they can to last till daylight.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Riveting Sci-Fi action-thriller Push is set in a deadly world of psychic espionage where the ability to move objects using only the mind, see the future, create new realities and kill without ever touching the victim can turn a person into a lethal weapon - or a target. A young man (Chris Evans - Sunshine, Fantastic Four ) and a teenage girl with extraordinary gifts (Dakota Fanning - War of the Worlds) take on a clandestine agency in a battle they can win only if they change the future.

programme.title: Waiting for Anya
programme.desc: From the mind of world-renowned author Michael Morpurgo comes the cinematic adaptation of Waiting for Anya - a powerful and authentic true story of a young shepherd that had a key part to play in one of the world's most shocking moments in history. Based on the novel by the author of War Horse, Waiting for Anya follows the story of Jo Lalande, a thirteen-year-old shepherd living in the mountain village of Lescun. Though Europe may be ravaged by the horrors of World War II, Jo's world in the French Pyrenees has remained remarkably untouched. That is, until a ferocious encounter with a bear introduces Jo to the mysterious Benjamin, a Jewish refugee who is desperately awaiting the arrival of his missing daughter, Anya, before making his escape across the border. Making friends with Benjamin and his mother-in-law Horcada, an isolated widow who lives in the nearby mountains, Jo becomes aware of a very dangerous secret - the family are involved in smuggling Jewish children over the mountains to the safety of Spain. In a heroic act of defiance, Jo promises to assist Benjamin in his endeavours...but soon becomes embroiled in a perilous conspiracy when German troops make their descent upon the village. Filmed in the village of Lescun and the surrounding Aspe Valley, France in which the true to life story also originated, the film boasts an all-stellar cast including Noah Schnapp (Stranger Things), Academy Award Winner Anjelica Huston (Ever After, The Addams Family), Jean Reno (Leon, The Big Blue, Ronin), Frederick Schmidt (Mission: Impossible - Fallout), Thomas Kretschmann (The Pianist, Central Intelligence) and Nicholas Rowe (Riviera, Lock Stock and Two Smoking Barrels).

programme.title: Pyewacket

Moving to record her album in a remote location, Grey realises theres a beastly secret lurking. Will her humanity be the price for fame and how much blood will be shed to secure a hit?

programme.title: Slumber

Sleep doctor Alice abandons all rational scientific reasoning while investigating a peculiar family case - a legendary demon that feeds on its victims by paralysing them in their sleep. To help this family from their nightmare, she must confront her own childhood demons to defeat this dark spirit. Truly eye-opening!

programme.title: Bauhaus Spirit
programme.desc: Almost a hundred years ago, a radical artistic utopia was born in the city of Weimar Bauhaus. This is a fascinating look at how it still shapes our world today. Against the background of the 100th anniversary 'Bauhaus Spirit: 100 Years of Bauhaus' not only tells art history, but also contemporary history. Bauhaus made art, design and architecture political. The result was a spatial art form that wasn't above thinking about the distance between a bathtub and a toilet or the ideal chair. We go back to the beginning and celebrate the cultural history of modern spatial thinking that is as captivating as it is enlightening.

programme.title: Trust No 1
programme.desc: Officer Bradley (Douglas Rouillard) investigates murders believed to be part of a serial killing and quickly learns it's much bigger. With the body count rising, and nothing adding up, he turns to his last resort for help, his brother.

programme.title: Kuku Mathur Ki Jhand Ho Gayee
programme.desc: A film about a young man named Kuku who dreams of becoming a successful entrepreneur. When he gets a job at a wedding planning company, he sees it as his ticket to the good life. However, his lack of experience and the chaotic wedding planning industry lead to hilarious mishaps and adventures.

programme.title: Maqbool
programme.desc: In Mumbai's criminal underworld, the lord of all lords is Jahangir Khan (Pankaj Kapoor). Those loyal to him include Maqbool (Irfan Khan), his chief. But Maqbool is in love with Nimmi (Tabu), Jahangir's mistress, who convinces him to be ambitious and take over the empire. After maneuvering potential rivals out of the way, Maqbool betrays Jahangir, murdering him in his own bed. However, it isn't long before both Maqbool and Nimmi are haunted by the ghosts of their treacherous deeds.

programme.title: Kisaan
programme.desc: The story of a farmer, Maan Singh, who struggles to save his ancestral land from corrupt officials and greedy businessmen. With the help of his son, he fights against the system and stands up for his rights as a farmer. The movie highlights the challenges faced by farmers in modern India and explores themes of family, tradition, and social justice in a poignant and inspiring plot.

programme.title: All The Best : Fun Begins
programme.desc: In order to receive pocket money from his wealthy brother, a man tells a lie that he gets trapped in. The fun begins when his friend suggests an idea to get them out of trouble, but ends up making the situation far worse.

programme.title: Paapnaashini Ganga
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Humkadam
programme.desc: Humkadam is a first of its kind show on Indian television that presents the complicated dynamics of ‘Saas' and ‘Bahu' in a clutter breaking manner. It tells the story of Tara and Shanti who are two diametrically opposite personalities, stuck in unprecedented situations. Just when they thought life had come to a full stop, is where they had to put their differences aside and start a new journey. Will they become each other's Humkadam to face all the adversities together?

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: SADHAK KAMALAKANTA
programme.desc: Sadhak Kamalakanta is a religious depiction of the extraordinary life of the saint Kamalakanta, from approximately the 15th century of undivided Bengal. As per the Hindu mythology, it is believed by many that Kamalakanta was blessed by the divine spirit of the Mother Goddess, in the images of not only Kali and Durga but also Jagatamba, Bishlakhi and Bhabani. It movie tells of his days as a boy where he was granted the skills of a learned hermit from a holy man, and that was the initiation into a life of religious belief. It portrays all hardships that Kamalakanta faced in his family life and criticism of the public, to have to choose between a family to take care of and the undeterred devotion to the Mother Goddess. The movie intends to spread the message hof Kamalakantaís teachings of love and peace and spiritual importance as a way of life rather than a blind religion of sorts that we follow.

programme.title: Armor Monster
programme.desc: One day, 12-year-old Zachary once again met the subway "0" which her mother took nine years ago, and the appearance of the subway seems to have some connection with the necklace left by her mother. In order to find her mother, Zachary stepped on the magic subway without hesitation! When the train arrived at the station, Zachary found that he had come to a magical world of elves. He also met the elf Rooney chased by hunters. In order to protect the Rooney, they fled to the underground city. Here, Zachary meets Scarlett, a red haired girl, and Zachary accidently becomes the Rooney and is regarded as a half-face hunter who is under searched with big bonus in the underground city. In order to leave the underground city to find his mother, Zachary has to agree to fight with the old wizard, the King of the underground city. Under Scarlett's training, Zachary grew up fast. In the battle, his determination to protect the Rooney inspired the strength in the necklace and defeated the old wizard. And just when the angry wizard decided to show his real strength, the real half hunter came to the rescue. The real half hunter even had the same necklace. The unexpected encounter of the two necklaces triggered the emergence of spirits and demons which are eager for energy. In order to protect the underground city from being ravage, the half-face hunter left the underground city with Zachary and his friends. They used their tactics to temporarily eliminate the demons in the stone forest near the beast forest, and they entered the beast forest to avoid refuge.

programme.title: Mid
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Kahi Suni
programme.desc: In a land steeped in mysticism, spirituality, and religion, the imagination of the followers has much room to flourish. Stories abound – some based on truth and some only on fractions of the truth. Nevertheless, these stories have enchanted their listeners for eons. Kahi Suni packs away our skepticism and takes us on a ride through the legendary tales of India. Each destination covered in the episodes has been the birthplace of a legend and each legend has given rise to the recognition of that location. Following our host from north to south and east to west, we journey through the land of myths of legends uncovering the origins of evIery story.

programme.title: The Way Back Home
programme.desc: Rohan Thakur finds his true calling as he begins a journey to revisit his roots in Himachal Pradesh. Way Back Home is as much a travelogue of childhood, as of growing up. Get ready for a journey of a lifetime

programme.title: Safarnama
programme.desc: Safarnama is more than just a mere journey one wants to complete just to check out that one task from the ‘ToDo List”. It is something just one of its kind. In Safarnama, we are up for a soulfulfilling journey with Ankit Siwach that is to begin in Mumbai and cease at Ladakh. This journey is to witness numerous unseen moments and unfelt experiences via a thrilling, adventurous route. It isn't just about navigating roads using GPS but more of digging deeper into the beauty of India to understand life better.

programme.title: Odd Jobs
programme.desc: "Odd Jobs" takes viewers on a fascinating journey into the world of unique and unconventional professions. This captivating series features a diverse array of careers, including celebrity impersonators, nude models, surrogate mothers, cricket ball inspectors, elephant dressers, prosthetic makeup artists, love helpline counselors, paranormal investigators, death photographers, and the dancing queen of Mumbai's local trains. Each episode delves into the lives of individuals who have chosen paths less traveled, showcasing their creativity, resilience, and passion. "Odd Jobs" celebrates the extraordinary ways people make a living, offering an intriguing glimpse into these one-of-a-kind professions.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: The new Mercedes-Benz GLC AMG Line World Premiere Teaser
programme.desc: The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. This adds striking design features and enhances the unique proportions of the vehicle. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern. The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

programme.title: The Mercedes EQS SUV Electric Art Line Driving Video
programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology - Colour change with the power of thought - The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.desc: To celebrate the arrival of the new Bentayga EWB, an exclusive First Edition is now available. Subject to a limited production run for the first twelve months of orders, it combines many of the most desirable options available for the car with a package of eye-catching details found only on Bentley First Editions. First Edition badging can be seen to the exterior of the car – a theme that extends inside, with badging on the veneered fascia, as well as embroidery on the seats. Unique First Edition contrast stitching and embroidery adorns the seats and, depending on the choice of veneers, handcrafted metal overlays just 0.075 mm thick can be applied to the fascia and waistrails in the front and the rear door veneer. The First Edition offers elegant and timeless design, focusing on maximum comfort and well-being. This specifically tailored specification includes a unique 22” ten-spoke directional wheel and bright lower bumper grilles. Other additional features as standard include unique quilted seats, mood lighting, a heated steering wheel, and increased driver's assistance aids. Attention to detail is clear, from the badging that identifies the car to the jewelled caps on the fuel and oil fillers.

programme.desc: The turbocharged three-litre flat-six in the new 911 GTS delivers 353 kW (480 PS). Maximum torque is 570 Nm, an increase of 20 Nm over its predecessor. Zero to 100 km/h takes just 3.3 seconds (911 Carrera 4 GTS: Fuel consumption combined (NEDC) 10.5 – 9.7 l/100 km, Fuel consumption combined (WLTP) 11.4 – 10.6 l/100 km, CO₂ emissions combined (NEDC) 240 – 222 g/km, CO₂ emissions combined (WLTP) 259 – 240 g/km) in the 911 Carrera 4 GTS Coupé with the eight-speed Porsche dual-clutch transmission (PDK): three tenths faster than its predecessor. A seven-speed manual transmission with a particularly short throw is available for all 911 GTS models as an alternative to the PDK.

programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID
programme.sub-title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz - How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. Also new: the ‘Memory Function' for automated parking on a previously saved route.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Product Highlights_en
programme.sub-title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF's Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly's ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky's own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly's horse wins the race. At Louisville's Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: 10 cose da fare prima di lasciarsi

programme.title: Totòtruffa '62

Il tutto per mantenere Diana, figlia di Antonio, in un lussuoso collegio. Sulle loro tracce, intanto si fa avanti il commissario Malvasia, ex compagno di scuola di Antonio.

programme.title: Il mio amico Jekyll
programme.desc: Grande commedia con Ugo Tognazzi e Raimondo Vianello. Il professor Giacinto, mite direttore di un istituto per ragazze malviventi, viene ogni notte rapito da un folle soprannominato "Dottor Jekyll," che gli inietta strani sieri. Giacinto si trasforma così nel sadico Professor Fabius, compiendo atti licenziosi e violenti sulle ragazze. Il suo segreto viene infine scoperto da un poliziotto.

programme.title: Il brigadiere Pasquale Zagaria ama la mamma e la polizia
programme.desc: Primo film da protagonista di Lino Banfi. Degradato e infine espulso dalla polizia per inettitudine comprovata, il brigadiere pugliese Pasquale Zagaria si ritira a vita privata nella campagna romana. Ma ben presto resta coinvolto in un oscuro traffico di diamanti. Con l'aiuto della vigorosa moglie Pupetta, cintura nera di karate, Zagaria torna ad affrontare i delinquenti.

programme.title: I Cadetti di Guascogna

Walter e Ugo hanno un debole per la bella Vittoria, ma il padre, che nulla vuole saperne, spedisce la ragazza a Bracciano, dalla zia. Caso vuole, però, che entrambi i pretendenti ricevano una chiamata che li destina proprio sulle rive del lago laziale dove, incontrata la dolce fanciulla, accade una cosa imprevista.

programme.title: 10th& Wolf

programme.title: Attenti a quelle due

Nel suo mondo ben ordinato scoppia Penny Rust (Rebel Wilson), un australiano che è in forma libera e amante del divertimento come Josephine è calcolata e astuta.

programme.title: Arma Micidiale

programme.title: End of sentence
programme.desc: Dopo essere rimasto vedovo, Frank intraprende un viaggio col figlio Sean appena uscito dal carcere per onorare l'ultimo desiderio di sua moglie di spargere le sue ceneri in un remoto lago in Irlanda.

programme.title: Mr. Magorium e la bottega
programme.desc: Molly Mahoney è la goffa e insicura della Bottega delle Meraviglie di Mr. Magorium, il negozio di giocattoli più strano e fantastico del mondo.

programme.title: Il fantastico mondo di Aladino
programme.desc: Calvin, un giovane commesso della pizza a domicilio, viene portato nella Bagdad dell'ottavo secolo grazie al Genio della lampada. Qui, con l'aiuto di Alì Babà e della principessa Sherazade, recupererà la lampada di Aladino.

programme.title: Jack Il Primate Più Verticale 2
programme.desc: Dopo essere stato cacciato dalla squadra di hockey, Jack incontra Ben, uno skateboarder ambizioso. Ben scopre che Jack è molto abile con lo skateboard e i due decidono di partecipare a una competizione di skateboard in giro per il paese!

programme.title: Bugged
programme.desc: CamouflageUn bagno per due S1:E1 Episodi 1-3 - Il buono, il cattivo e il puzzone

programme.title: Bugged
programme.desc: AbracatastrofeS1:E17 Episodi 49-52 - Doggonit Il miraggioAnime gemelle

programme.title: Corneil & Bernie
programme.desc: S1:E24 Un vero amico - Romeo, rimasto in città e senza amici, prtiti per le vacanze, si serve di Bernie e della sua compagnia, spacciandosi per “vero amico”. Ma Corneil sa perfettamente cos'è la vera amicizia!

programme.title: Baba Yaga
programme.desc: La fotografa Valentina mentre una notte sta tornando a casa rischia di essere travolta da un'automobile guidata da una strana donna dal misterioso nome di Baba Yaga. Dopo questo incontro Valentina, inspiegabilmente attratta dal mistero che circonda la donna, viene coinvolta in un'avventura fatta di magia, mistero e sensualità.

programme.title: Giallo
programme.desc: Regia del maestro italiano del brivido Dario Argento. Giallo è un serial killer che uccide donne bellissime di passaggio in città. La sua ultima preda è la giovane modella Celine ma, questa volta, Giallo commette un errore che potrebbe essergli fatale, che metterà sulle sue tracce l'ispettore Enzo Avolfi, affiancato da Linda, la sorella di Celine.

programme.title: Devilman Story
programme.desc: Il giornalista Mike Harway aiuta la sua amica Christine nella ricerca del padre di lei, un famoso chirurgo che è stato misteriosamente rapito. Le ricerche li portano in Africa, dove i due giovani vengono fatti prigionieri e condotti in un fortino abbandonato. In quell'oscuro posto, il folle scienziato Devilman sta mettendo a punto un progetto di trapianto di cervello.

programme.title: L'infermiera
programme.desc: Quando un vedovo anziano inizia a soffrire di problemi cardiaci, i suoi avidi eredi sperano di accelerarlo assumendo un'infermiera super seducente per fargli battere il cuore

programme.title: Il boss
programme.desc: Film Cult di Fernando di Leo. Lanzetta, uno spietato killer, si introduce in un cinema durante la proiezione di un film e massacra la gang del boss Antonino Attardi, colpevole di aver accolto tra le sue file Cocchi, un killer della 'Ndrangheta che vende informazioni alla commissione antimafia, e che mira a diventare membro di Cosa Nostra. Ha così inizio una guerra sanguinaria.

programme.title: L'ingorgo
programme.desc: Un corteo di macchine procede sempre più lentamente lungo la tangenziale di Roma, sino a che ogni possibilità di movimento si blocca. L`ingorgo durerà 36 ore. Sin dai primi momenti il nervosismo dei viaggiatori è evidente. Quando sfumano le speranze di una veloce soluzione, mancano notizie, si palesano le prime necessità, la tensione sale al massimo e non pochi trascendono. La circostanza permette di scoprire i lati peggiori dell`umanità presente...

programme.title: Cassandra Crossing
programme.desc: Due terroristi entrano in un laboratorio dove si sperimentano armi batteriologiche prodotte dai servizi segreti e contraggono un terribile virus. Uno dei due riesce a fuggire e a salire sul treno per Stoccolma dove contagia alcuni passeggeri. Ma i servizi segreti rintracciano il convoglio e decidono di deviarlo verso la Polonia. Lo scopo è farlo precipitare su un ponte pericolante il Cassandra Crossing, in modo che tutti muoiano e si perdano le tracce del terribile segreto...

programme.title: Vita da cani
programme.desc: Tre ragazze condividono un sogno: fare fortuna. Franca è occupata in una fabbrica ed stanca di fare la vita dell`operaia: abbandona quindi il fidanzato, un giovane meccanico, per recarsi a Roma, dove spera di trovare un ricco amante.Vera è una ballerina in una compagnia di guitti del varietà che abbandona i suoi sogni per amore. Margherita, invece, è una timida ragazzina che sogna di intraprendere la carriera di attrice...

programme.title: Piccolo mondo antico
programme.desc: Durante il Risorgimento, un giovane di nobile casato sposa, contro il volere della nonna austricante, una donna borghese e va a vivere sul lago di Como. La loro bambina annega per una svista fatale, e la giovane madre quasi impazzisce. Si riprende solo quando lo sposo, che intanto ha aderito ai movimenti clandestini rivoluzionari, annuncia la sua partenza per la guerra di Crimea.

programme.title: Angeli Ribelli
programme.desc: Irlanda, 1939. William Franklin, di ritorno dalla guerra civile spagnola dove ha perso la moglie, diventa insegnante di poesia e letteratura nel riformatorio di St.Jude gestito da preti cattolici. I suoi metodi di insegnamento gli fanno guadagnare la fiducia dei ragazzi, ma vengono visti con sospetto dal resto dei docenti e dal severo preside Fratello John, che è fautore di metodi didattici più severi e crudeli.

programme.title: Dopo l'amore
programme.desc: Marie e Boris, dopo quindici anni di matrimonio, vivono separati in casa a causa di difficoltà economiche e per il bene delle figlie. Questo dramma contemporaneo esplora i paradossi e le sfide di una relazione che si sgretola lentamente.

programme.title: Remember
programme.desc: Remember racconta la storia di Zev (Christopher Plummer), che scopre che la guardia nazista responsabile della morte della sua famiglia vive in America sotto falso nome. Nonostante le difficoltà, Zev decide di farsi giustizia da solo, intraprendendo un viaggio intercontinentale con conseguenze inaspettate.

programme.title: Milk
programme.desc: Attivista del movimento dei diritti degli omosessuali. Amico. Amante. Unificatore. Politico. Combattente. Icona. Ispiratore. Eroe. La sua vita ha cambiato la storia, e il suo coraggio ha cambiato la vita di tante persone.

programme.title: La casa del custode
programme.desc: Dopo l' omicidio della moglie e dei figli Jacob, compositore dilettante di Brooklyn, comincia a vagare senza meta, sperando di comprendere la tragedia che gli è occorsa. Per puro caso arriva a Brent, in Alabama. Qui viene accolto da Nina, madre single e cantante di un coro gospel. Grazie al potere della musica, Jacob comincerà a guardare nuovamente al futuro.

programme.title: IL KIT DELL'AMORE
programme.desc: Quando il padre di Olivia, modellista, decide di andare in pensione, lei è convinta di essere la candidata ideale per succedergli. Ma poi arriva Simon, il cui modo di pensare fuori dagli schemi minaccia di sconvolgere la tranquilla vita di Olivia e il suo ruolo di erede.

programme.title: TRE APPUNTAMENTI PER INNAMORARSI
programme.desc: Maddie è una conduttrice della radio locale, John un imprenditore che ha creato un'app per cui in 3 appuntamenti ti trova l'anima gemella. Lei è così scettica che diventa un tester. I tre appuntamenti basta ma l'anima gemella si rielerà proprio John

programme.title: TUTTA COLPA DEL CIOCCOLATO
programme.desc: Pochi giorni prima di una gara tra cioccolatieri, Aria si trova senza compagno di squadra. Dopo aver pubblicato un annuncio online, Ryan si offre come sostituo. Ma il loro andare d'accordo sarà legato solo al cioccolato?

programme.title: LA MELODIA DEL MIO CUORE
programme.desc: Bonnie, proprietaria di un tea shop e cresciuta con la musica, aiuta un musicista a scrivere i testi del suo nuovo album grazie al suo talento naturale con le parole.

programme.title: Un week end da leone
programme.desc: Dave, Spider e Woody sono tre studenti di L.A. in viaggio per Tijuana, in Messico, dove intendono perdere la loro verginità alla spedizione partecipa anche Wendell, fratello di Dave, che li segue per comprare dei fuochi d'artificio.

programme.title: Darling Companion
programme.desc: Una mattina Beth salva un cane randagio e, nonostante il parere contrario del marito Joseph, decide di tenerlo con sé instaurandovi un legame speciale per compensare la solitudine della propria vita matrimoniale. Con Diane Keaton.

programme.title: Ti presento Bill
programme.desc: Stufo della sua vita, Bill si ritrova mentore di un adolescente indisciplinato ma curiosamente saggio. Quando scopre il tradimento della moglie, Bill non ha più nulla da perdere e si rivolge al ragazzo come modello di ispirazione per cambiare esistenza.

programme.title: East Is East
programme.desc: Nel 1971 George Khan, pakistano tradizionalista, è emigrato nel Regno Unito dove possiede un negozio di fish & chips e ha sposato Ella. I loro sette figli sembrano poco inclini a seguire le direttive paterne per quanto riguarda la religione islamica.

programme.title: Awake Anestesia cosciente
programme.desc: Sebbene il suo corpo sia completamente paralizzato dall'anestesia, Clay rimane consapevole per tutta la durata dell'intervento, sperimentando così la 'consapevolezza intraoperatoria'. Questa esperienza, tra il delirio e la realtà, avrà ripercussioni nella sua vita perché emergeranno segreti nascosti.

programme.title: Undead or alive
programme.desc: Cowboy contro zombie in un West delirante. Tra gag, inseguimenti e non-morti, sopravvivere è l'unica missione.

programme.title: La casa del diavolo
programme.desc: Sequel del sanguinoso 'La casa dei mille corpi', la psicotica famiglia Firefly vaga senza meta, lasciando sulla strada una scia di morte e distruzione. È, però, braccata da uno sceriffo feroce e due cacciatori di taglie senza scrupoli: la caccia sarà spietata.

programme.title: 47 Metri: Uncaged
programme.desc: Un'immersione tra le rovine di una città sommersa si trasforma in un incubo. Quattro amiche sono intrappolate sott'acqua, circondate da squali letali e cunicoli che sembrano stringersi attorno a loro. Sopravvivere richiede sangue freddo… e pura fortuna.

programme.title: Killer Grades
programme.desc: Katherine, mamma orgogliosa, ha appena scoperto che sua figlia Michelle si è guadagnata un posto nella squadra di decathlon accademico! Ma quando il padre di uno studente muore ed un altro finisce in ospedale, Katherine inizia a chiedersi se nella squadra non ci sia qualcosa di più di quanto lei sappia...

programme.title: Il Rapimento di Evan
programme.desc: Elizabeth e suo marito si godono la gioia dell'essere neo-genitori. Quando Elizabeth apre un blog per documentare l'esperienza e suo figlio Evan viene rapito, capisce che il pericolo è molto più vicino di quanto pensasse.

programme.title: Detective McLean
programme.desc: Uno dei dipendenti di Matt rimane coinvolto in un giro di schiavitù e si rivolge ad Allison per chiederle aiuto. Cameron e Mariah vanno a trovare Tim in prigione per il suo compleanno.

programme.title: Detective McLean
programme.desc: Allison e Devin indagano sulla morte di un potente amministratore delegato. Nel frattempo, Jackie, la madre di Cameron e Mariah, Jackie, torna a casa dalla riabilitazione.

programme.title: Detective McLean
programme.desc: Allison e Devin indagano sulla morte di un potente amministratore delegato. Nel frattempo, Jackie, la madre di Cameron e Mariah, Jackie, torna a casa dalla riabilitazione.

programme.title: Lo scatto perfetto
programme.desc: Alla fotografa di matrimoni, Lindsey, si presenta una grande opportunità quando il figlio di un magnate di New York, Josh, le chiede di fotografare il matrimonio della sorella. Durante i preparamenti del matrimonio, scocca la scintilla tra Josh e Lindsey, costringendo entrambi a rendersi conto di quanto abbiano negato le loro vere emozioni. Con i preparativi del matrimonio in pieno svolgimento e l'arrivo di ospiti prestigiosi, Josh e Lindsey si trovano ora di fronte a una scelta difficile: tornare semplicemente alla loro vita di sempre o correre il rischio di seguire il loro cuore.

programme.title: Un matrimonio movimentato
programme.desc: Darcy, una organizzatrice di eventi, torna nella sua città natale per organizzare il matrimonio della madre. Tuttavia fa fatica ad accettare il futuro patrigno e ben presto la sua ossessione per la perfezione inizia a scontrarsi con il desiderio della madre di organizzare una cerimonia sobria.

programme.title: The Clue to Love
programme.desc: L'ambiziosa Audrey Harper si reca a Hope Cove per scrivere sulla speciale ma anonima rubrica di consigli amorosi Chiedi a zia Hope, un pilastro del giornale locale della città. Incontra così l'affascinante caporedattore Morgan Cooper, che la aiuta a scoprire la vera identità della "zia Hope".

programme.title: Inaspettate passioni
programme.desc: Dopo una pesante separazione, la giornalista Dana Willingham si ritrova sola e bloccata in un ritiro di yoga per coppie, mentre l'evento più importante della sua carriera sta accadendo lontano. E non le piace nemmeno lo yoga!

programme.title: Una pasticceria da amare
programme.desc: Jessie Dale è una pasticcera di terza generazione che ama la sua pasticceria più di ogni altra cosa al mondo. Quando dei costruttori minacciano di acquistare il suo edificio costringendola ad andarsene, dovrà fare tutto il possibile per salvare la sua pasticceria.

programme.title: Le pagine della mia vita
programme.desc: Quando Lisa torna nella sua città natale per cercare ispirazione per la sua nuova linea di moda, si ritrova ad aiutare la sua migliore amica a prepararsi alla nascita del primo figlio.

programme.title: Ti va di ballare?
programme.desc: La vita di un vedovo prende una svolta inaspettata quando si mette in viaggio per cercare l'amore perduto di un uomo che sta morendo.

programme.title: Due cuori e una baita
programme.desc: Workaholic Jillian plants to sell an inherited mountainside cabin, but a handsome caretaker Liam makes an offer. Sparks fly as they transform the cabin into a holiday resort. But when business doesn't go to plan, will Jillian give up everything for love?

programme.title: Lamore è complicato
programme.desc: Leah è una scrittrice che nella propria vita ha sempre cercato di evitare ogni conflitto, ma grazie a un'esperienza inaspettata riesce a trovare la propria forza interiore e a stringere nuove amicizie.

programme.title: Natale alle Highlands
programme.desc: GIRATO IN SCOZIA. Questo Natale, Blair Henderson, un'esperta di profumi di New York, viene inviata dal suo capo nella remota Scozia per trovare una rara fragranza scozzese, The Heart of the Highlands.

programme.title: Lovers
programme.desc: Tradimenti, vendette, amori e colpi di scena animano quattro storie parallele interpretate dai medesimi attori sullo sfondo di Bologna. Amore, commedia, dubbio e sospetto si fondono nel film italiano pluripremiato all'estero.

programme.title: L'amore dietro la maschera
programme.desc: Elyse e Rob vivono una moderna e capovolta versione della storia d'amore raccontata dalla fiaba di ...

programme.title: L'amore dietro la maschera
programme.desc: Elyse e Rob vivono una moderna e capovolta versione della storia d'amore raccontata dalla fiaba di ...

programme.title: La signora di Purity Falls
programme.desc: Una vedova si trasferisce a Purity Falls ma il rapporto con suo figlio si deteriora presto.

programme.title: La signora di Purity Falls
programme.desc: Una vedova si trasferisce a Purity Falls ma il rapporto con suo figlio si deteriora presto.

programme.title: Il fiume della vita
programme.desc: In Australia, madre e figlia trovano l'amore e la riconciliazione tra due culture in conflitto.

programme.title: Il fiume della vita
programme.desc: In Australia, madre e figlia trovano l'amore e la riconciliazione tra due culture in conflitto.

programme.title: Il fiume della vita
programme.desc: A Varanasi, Robert ritrova se stesso cercando la bambina della sorella morta in India.

programme.title: Il fiume della vita
programme.desc: A Varanasi, Robert ritrova se stesso cercando la bambina della sorella morta in India.

programme.title: L'amore dietro la maschera
programme.desc: Elyse e Rob vivono una moderna e capovolta versione della storia d'amore raccontata dalla fiaba di ...

programme.title: Melancholia
programme.desc: Justine arriva con il neomarito alla festa delle nozze che il cognato e la sorella Claire le hanno organizzato con un ritmato protocollo. Justine sorride molto ma dentro di sé prova un disagio profondo che la spingerà ad allontanarsi in più occasioni dai festeggiamenti provocando lo sconcerto di molti, marito compreso. Non si tratta però solo di un malessere esistenziale privato. Una grave minaccia incombe sulla Terra: il pianeta Melancholia si sta avvicinando e, benché il mondo scientifico inviti all'ottimismo, il rischio di collisione e di distruzione totale del globo terrestre è più che mai realistico.

programme.title: Briciole sul mare
programme.desc: Un anonimo pescatore pugliese viene rinvenuto sulle coste siciliane dai fratelli Salvo, promesso sposo di Maria, e Manuele, suo ex compagno. Quando Salvo fa per offrire alla donna un bracciale ritrovato in mare, si scoprirà che il gioiello le era stato donato in precedenza proprio da Manuele. Impossessatosene nuovamente, questi lo aveva poi regalato a Marta, ex amante di Salvo quindi, per vendetta, del fratello. Tornato ancora nelle sue mani, lo aveva infine venduto a un rigattiere. Le cose si complicano quando la polizia recupera il cadavere di una donna che Salvo identifica come la stessa Marta.

programme.title: Fuggiamo insieme
programme.desc: Quando una ragazza appena sposata scopre che suo marito è un nazista, lo lascia e scappa con un giornalista radiofonico che si innamora di lei mentre la segue alla ricerca di una storia su suo marito.

programme.title: Una Vita da Sogno
programme.desc: Una commedia sul gioco degli equivoci condita con una buona dose d'ironia e arti marziali. Il protagonista infatti si finge quello che non è per cercare di conquistare una bella ragazza… Ma anche lei a sua volta fa la stessa cosa. E quindi inizia una girandola di situazioni inaspettate ed esilaranti…

programme.title: Fughe da fermo
programme.desc: Tratto dall'omonimo romanzo dello stesso Edoardo Nesi, il film racconta il disagio esistenziale e la mancanza di ideali di un gruppo di ragazzi che reagisce al vuoto da cui si sente circondato organizzando atti di rivolta. È solo la trasgressione a far sentire 'vivi' Fede e i suoi amici, che compiono gli atti più bizzarri con il solo scopo di dare un senso alla loro esistenza.

programme.title: La canzone più triste del mondo
programme.desc: Durante la Grande Depressione, nella cittadina di Winnipeg, una baronessa indice un concorso per trovare la canzone più triste del mondo. Musicisti da tutto il mondo accorreranno per vincere il primo premio: 25 mila dollari. Un musical grottesco e fantastico, diretto da un grande regista, purtroppo poco conosciuto in Italia: Guy Maddin.

programme.title: Tutto Ciò che Voglio
programme.desc: Wendy è Autistica, viene aiutata dalla terapia della struttura specializzata di Scottie, proteggendo la sua rigida routine quotidiana e permettendo che la ragazza coltivi la sua passione, ovvero la visione della saga televisiva Star Trek.

programme.title: Papi Chulo
programme.desc: A Los Angeles, un solitario e alienato meteorologo televisivo "assume" un migrante latinoamericano di mezza età per essere suo amico.

programme.title: Mi sdoppio in 4
programme.desc: A Doug Kinney (Michael Keaton) servirebbe un miracolo. Marito devoto, padre e uomo d'affari, con una moglie adorante (Andie MacDowell), ha poco tempo per godersi casa e lavoro. Doug è quasi sul punto di scoppiare quando incontra Dr. Owen Leeds (Harris Yulin), genetista, che gli offre la possibilità di sdoppiare la sua personalità facendosi clonare.

programme.title: Quel Nano Infame
programme.desc: Un boss malavitoso offre al ladro di gioielli (alto circa 90 cm e rilasciato di recente con la condizionale) Calvin Sims e al suo partner Percy 100.000 dollari per rubare un famoso diamante. Ma la rapina fallisce e Calvin fa cadere il gioiello nella borsetta di Vanessa Edwards.

programme.title: Poliziotti A Domicilio
programme.desc: Chevy Chase, Jack Palance e Dianne Wiest sono i protagonisti di questa commedia su un mite contabile i cui sogni di diventare un super poliziotto diventano comicamente realtà. Alla ricerca di un pericoloso falsario, il duro poliziotto Jake Stone (Palance) convince una famiglia di periferia a prestargli la casa per un'operazione di sorveglianza a lungo termine. Ma questa 'tipica' famiglia è tutto fuorché tipica, con un padre eccessivamente goffo (Chase) la cui ossessione per i telefilm polizieschi mette a repentaglio l'intera operazione. Con il regista e la star di Fletch di nuovo insieme, COPS & ROBBERSONS offre comicità ad alta velocità, gag visive e commedia fisica per un divertimento assicurato.

programme.title: Only You
programme.desc: Marisa Tomei è Faith che crede fermamente negli astri e sin da ragazza una chiromante le predice che l'uomo della sua vita sarà un certo Damon Bradley. Pochi giorni prima di sposare un podologo, finalmente arriva la telefonata di Damon per farle gli augur mentre sta per partire per Venezia.

programme.title: Tutte le ex del mio ragazzo
programme.desc: Brittany Murphy catturerà il vostro cuore in questo divertentissimo film su una brava ragazza che non ne combina una giusta. Assunta per lavorare in un talk show televisivo, la vita di Stacy Holt è stravolta quando viene convinta ad esplorare uno dei temi del programma e controlla l'agenda del suo ragazzo. Ma si è dimenticata una cosa: nel mondo della TV, c'è sempre una sorpresa scioccante dietro l'angolo -- e lei ne avrà una bella grande!

programme.title: La pretora
programme.desc: Una pretora inflessibili affronta i ricatti dei rivali che usano la gemella pornostar, ma lei reagisce con fermezza

programme.title: Pane, burro e marmellata
programme.desc: Bruno, lasciato dalla moglie, trova rifugio da tre donne e diventa il sultano del loro piccolo harem

programme.title: Le inibizioni del dottor Gaudenzi vedovo col complesso della buonanima
programme.desc: Il dottor Gaudenzi, giura fedeltà eterna alla moglie morta, ma è perseguitato da incidenti con le donne

programme.title: Tutti a squola
programme.desc: Un professore all'antica finisce in galera per droga e guadagna popolarità tra gli studenti

programme.title: Aragosta a colazione
programme.desc: Enrico fallisce il suicidio e finisce nei guai recitando la parte del marito per un amico

programme.title: Quel fantasma di mio marito
programme.desc: Un uomo, ucciso in un incidente, ritorna come un "fantasma" per aiutare la sua moglie a superare il dolore della sua morte e a trovare la felicità. Una commedia che gioca su spirito e sentimenti in modo divertente e malinconico.

programme.title: Anni difficili
programme.desc: Con Umberto Spadaro, Massimo Girotti e Ave Ninchi, Aldo Piscitello deve aderire al Partito Fascista e affrontare la guerra. Tra doveri familiari e scelte morali, cerca il coraggio di restare fedele a sé stesso in un'Italia in crisi.

programme.title: La donna scimmia
programme.desc: Commedia grottesca di Marco Ferreri con Ugo Tognazzi: Antonio scopre Maria, tutta pelosa, e la porta in tournée come fenomeno da baraccone. Tra scherzi, equivoci e situazioni assurde, il loro strano duo regala risate e sorprese.

programme.title: Il fischio al naso
programme.desc: Un uomo, interpretato da Ugo Tognazzi, si ritrova coinvolto in una serie di situazioni comiche e paradossali, tutto a causa di un fischio al naso che cambia inaspettatamente la sua vita. Una commedia surreale e ironica che esplora la follia delle circostanze.

programme.title: Fanboys
programme.desc: Un gruppo di fan di Star Wars raggiunge lo Skywalker Ranch per rubare una copia di "The Phantom Menace," così che il loro amico, un malato terminale, possa vederlo prima che esca al cinema.

programme.title: Ti presento Bill
programme.desc: Stufo della sua vita, Bill si ritrova mentore di un adolescente indisciplinato ma curiosamente saggio. Quando scopre il tradimento della moglie, Bill non ha più nulla da perdere e si rivolge al ragazzo come modello di ispirazione per cambiare la propria esistenza.

programme.title: Next Day Air
programme.desc: Un incauto fattorino consegna inavvertitamente all'indirizzo sbagliato un pacco contenente panetti di cocaina occultati.

programme.title: Fratelli in erba
programme.desc: Edward Norton interpreta il doppio ruolo di un professore di filosofia, Bill Kincaid e del suo fratello gemello: un criminale professionista e coltivatore di marijuana, che lo coinvolgerà in un brutto affare causandogli guai con la giustizia…

programme.title: Miseria e nobiltà
programme.desc: In pieno Ottocento, Felice e Pasquale, due poveri napoletani, uno scrivano ed un fotografo, devono fingere di essere gli aristocratici parenti del marchese per cui lavorano per riuscire a sbarcare il lunario.

programme.title: East Is East
programme.desc: Nel 1971 George Khan, pakistano tradizionalista, è emigrato nel Regno Unito dove possiede un negozio di fish & chips e ha sposato Ella. I loro sette figli sembrano poco inclini a seguire le direttive paterne per quanto riguarda la religione islamica.

programme.title: Lovers
programme.desc: Tradimenti, vendette, amori e colpi di scena animano quattro storie parallele interpretate dai medesimi attori sullo sfondo di Bologna. Amore, commedia, dubbio e sospetto si fondono nel film italiano pluripremiato all'estero.

programme.title: I complessi

programme.title: Love shooting
programme.desc: Charlie è un produttore cinematografico che si lascia convincere a realizzare un film su Benjamin Disraeli, a patto che il protagonista sia un attore di grande fama che però verrà rapito, costringendo Charlie ad escogitare una soluzione creativa.

programme.title: Killer Adios

Grazie al suo incarico, Jess inizia a indagare su una serie di delitti, con il dubbio che l'autore possa essere proprio Jack. Diretto da Primo Zeglio con Peter Lee Lawrence

programme.title: Black Jack

programme.title: F.T.W.

programme.desc: Quando scopre che sua figlia Hanna è stata rapita, Luke - un ex agente delle forze si trasforma nuovamente in una macchina da guerra e si lancia alla ricerca del responsabile per consumare la sua vendetta.

programme.desc: Dopo un bacio spontaneo, una designer si innamora del fidanzato della sua titolare mentre decora la casa per Natale.

programme.title: My Old Lady
programme.desc: A Parigi, Mathias eredita un appartamento, ma un'anziana inquilina lo lega a un costoso contratto.

programme.title: Letters to Juliet
programme.desc: A Verona, Sophie trova una lettera d'amore di 50 anni fa e aiuta Claire a ritrovare il suo amore perduto.

programme.title: The Last Survivors
programme.desc: In un futuro molto prossimo, le risorse di acqua dolce si sono esaurite e la civiltà è sull'orlo del collasso. Un avido "barone dell'acqua" è determinato a spazzare via ogni sopravvissuto. Solo Kendal, una coraggiosa diciassettenne, potrà con determinazione e grinta lottare per ciò che è giusto.

programme.title: Sea fever
programme.desc: Una misteriosa creatura ha intrappolato il peschereccio su cui Siobhán, solitaria studentessa di biologia marina, sta facendo delle ricerche. Nella lotta per la sopravvivenza, Siobhán dovrà guadagnarsi la fiducia dell'equipaggio.

programme.title: Superdeep
programme.desc: Nel 1984, al Circolo polare artico, il Kola Superdeep Borehole è il più grande laboratorio segreto dell'URSS, situato a 12 mila metri sotto terra. Pochi mesi dopo l'apertura del sito, gli scienziati registrano voci e urla di origine sconosciuta.

programme.title: Horror Express
programme.desc: Mentre si trovano sul Trans-Siberian Express, un antropologo e il suo rivale devono contenere la minaccia rappresentata dal carico del primo: una scimmia preistorica che ospita una forma di vita parassitaria.

programme.title: Captive State
